description: External W6IWI HF development recordings. Source-described test patterns; no trusted aligned transcripts or scored reception results.
redistribution_status: Page invites demodulator testing; no explicit audio redistribution grant identified. Originals, derivatives and captures remain external.
partition_policy: All three recordings and their derivatives are development material inspected during intake. No held-out assignment or evidence is claimed.

conversion.boundary_mapping: output sample boundary = floor(original sample boundary * output_rate / 8000)
conversion.delay_policy: Offline src_simple with complete input and end_of_input=1. No trimming or padding; floor(input_frames * output_rate / input_rate) output frames required. Filter edge transients retained.
conversion.clipping_policy: Fixed 0.5 input gain; reject any resampled float magnitude >= 1 before PCM16 rounding.

settings_basis: Provisional fixed reference settings: 45.45 baud, US figures and 1.5 stops are comparator settings, not measured transmitter parameters. Exploratory two-second Hann spectra identified the 40 m tone pair near 2050/2220 Hz, and 20 m/RY near 2125/2295 Hz. Mark-low assignments are supported by exploratory minimodem text. Exact baud, stop timing and transmitted controls remain unverified.

fixtures.source_description: TU-170 test tape transmitted from Tucson, Arizona; received at KFS SDR. Source describes 50 W on 40 m into a random-length wire, with severe fading.
fixtures.source_pattern: Quick Brown Fox repeated 100 times; exact tape text and controls are not supplied.

fixtures.source_description: TU-170 test tape transmitted from Tucson, Arizona; received at KFS SDR. Source describes 90 W on 20 m into an inverted L.
fixtures.source_pattern: Quick Brown Fox repeated 100 times; exact tape text and controls are not supplied.

fixtures.source_description: Source describes 4 W from Tucson into a 30-foot vertical, received at KFS SDR.

original_container_note: All three WebSDR originals overstate RIFF size by eight bytes. The fmt/data chunks and declared PCM sample payloads are complete. This anomaly is explicitly allowed only through original artifact metadata; originals are never rewritten. Derived WAVs have standard RIFF sizes.
